HERO.LEAD: bibo is a visual workspace. Documents, notes and ideas share one surface, and every number traces back to the exact page it came from. Try it right below.
HERO.NOTE: Early days, single user. The final name is not settled yet.

SKETCH.AI_HINT: AI suggests, you accept or dismiss

PROBLEM.LEAD: Work with many documents at once and you run into this:
PROBLEM.ITEM_1: PDFs in one folder, notes in another app, conclusions in your head.
PROBLEM.ITEM_2: You write down a number, a week later you cannot remember which page it came from.
PROBLEM.ITEM_3: Spreadsheets and docs are rigid, visual tools cannot tie data to its source.
PROBLEM.ILLU_ALT: A person standing among scattered files, notes and question marks

PILLARS.TITLE: Three things, one surface
PILLARS.LEAD: No extra app. bibo brings the three things you already use separately into one place.
PILLARS.SOURCE_BODY: PDFs, images, web clips. The original documents, reopened at the exact page and passage.
PILLARS.NOTE_BODY: Write your own, or quote straight from a source. Quoted notes always remember where they came from.
PILLARS.CANVAS_BODY: An infinite surface. Drag, connect, nest boards inside boards, see the whole picture.

FEATURES.TITLE: A closer look
FEATURES.PROV_BODY: Each object on the canvas keeps its origin: which file, which page, which table. One click opens the exact passage.
FEATURES.PROV_1: No more floating data of unknown origin.
FEATURES.PROV_2: The Inspector shows source, confidence and relations of the selected object.
FEATURES.PROV_3: Conclusions you can re-check, and others can trust.
FEATURES.PROV_ALT: Note "Q3 revenue +18%" quoted from table 3 on page 12, with the Inspector showing its source
FEATURES.CANVAS_BODY: Drag, zoom, undo. Tidy notes, with the toolbar right at hand.
FEATURES.CANVAS_1: Zoom without drift: the point under your cursor stays put.
FEATURES.CANVAS_2: Drag a note from the toolbar straight onto the board.
FEATURES.CANVAS_3: Undo, redo, and a shortcut to see everything.
FEATURES.CANVAS_POINTER_BODY: The canvas at the top is a trimmed try-out that runs right in your browser and saves nothing.
FEATURES.CANVAS_POINTER_LINK: Go back up and try again
FEATURES.AI_BODY: Visual like a pinboard, with intelligence underneath. AI helps connect and analyse, you still make the call.
FEATURES.AI_1: Compare two tables and point out what changed.
FEATURES.AI_2: Extract tables from a PDF into objects, keeping the source.
FEATURES.AI_ALT: Two tables Q2 and Q3, AI suggests a comparison link and circles the changed cell

STEPS.TITLE: Three steps, nothing to learn
STEPS.LEAD: Open a board, drop things in, start connecting. That is it.
STEPS.S1_BODY: Drag PDFs, images, links into Unsort. No need to arrange yet, just collect.
STEPS.S2_BODY: Drag from Unsort onto the board, write notes, group with nested boards.
STEPS.S3_BODY: Draw links between objects. Doubt a number? Open its source and see.

ROADMAP.TITLE: One step at a time, no rewrites
ROADMAP.LEAD: bibo is designed from day one to grow: from one person, to many people, to whole teams sharing a workspace.
ROADMAP.STICKY_BODY: bibo is at step 1 for now: the canvas and notes work. Other object types, AI and collaboration are on the way.
ROADMAP.ALT: Three steps: one person, an account per person, a shared collaborative workspace

FINAL.BODY: bibo is being built stroke by stroke. The canvas works today, the rest is still being sketched.

FOOTER.NAME: bibo · working name, may become BiBaNote
